facts.text: Jon expressed excitement about the upcoming event and mentioned that it has been a wild ride, but he is feeling good and ready to give it his best.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! I'm excited! It's been a wild ride, but I'm feeling good and ready to give it my best.

facts.text: Gina praised Jon for his progress and encouraged him to savor the joy and thrill of the event, calling it magical.

evidence.quote: Wow, Jon, you must be so excited! You've come so far since we last talked, and tomorrow's gonna be a blast! All those long nights were worth it - so take some time to savor it. Capture the joy and thrill that dance brings - it's magical!

facts.text: Jon confirmed that the official opening night is tomorrow and expressed his intention to savor all the good vibes and enjoy the moment.

evidence.quote: The official opening night is tomorrow. I'm working hard to make everything just right. Can't wait to see it all come together!
Tomorrow's gonna be an awesome night and I'm not gonna forget a second of it. I put so much into this and I want to savor all the good vibes.

facts.text: Gina expressed pride in Jon and encouraged him to enjoy the good feelings of the event, stating that he earned it.

evidence.quote: I'm always proud of you. Enjoy the good feels tomorrow, you earned it.
